description: Rank schools against the user's weighted criteria (1-8: any school measure from list_school_measures, weight 1-5, higher or lower is better, optional must range) within a pool (near a point, one council, one region, or England) and the map's Schools filter (phase, Ofsted, type, intake, faith). Returns each school's score (weighted mean of its percentiles in the pool), rank and per-criterion value with year and source; a missing value is listed, never a zero. With area_id (an LSOA from find_areas) each school also carries straight-line metres from that neighbourhood. Independent schools are a separate unranked list. Pupil-mix measures score nothing while CLOSE_KNIT_SCHOOL_PUPIL_MIX_RANKED is off. A ranking never promises a school place.

direction.description: 'higher' or 'lower' is better; blank takes the measure's default.
direction.title: Direction

measure.description: Measure id from list_school_measures, e.g. ks4-attainment8 (find_areas' spellings such as ks2RwmExpected work too).
measure.title: Measure

must_max.description: Must be at most this (a filter, no weight).
must_max.title: Must Max

must_min.description: Must be at least this (a filter, no weight).
must_min.title: Must Min

bad.description: What was wrong, missing or confusing.
bad.title: Bad

call_id.description: The callId of the answer you are rating; leave it out when answers carry none.
call_id.title: Call Id

fix.description: The change to the tool or its answer you would want.
fix.title: Fix

good.description: What was useful in the answer.
good.title: Good

rating.description: 1 = useless or wrong, 3 = usable with gaps, 5 = exactly what was needed.
rating.title: Rating

area_id.description: A neighbourhood (LSOA) from find_areas, e.g. uk:lsoa:E01000951: every school gets metres from it; the near pool centres on it without lat/lng.
area_id.title: Area Id

council.description: council pool: the local authority's name, e.g. Ealing.
council.title: Council

filter.description: Schools filter text as the map's ?schools= (on = every school), e.g. t.s_o.out.good
filter.title: Filter

intent.description: Optional, one to three sentences you write: what the user is looking for with this call and the criteria that matter, e.g. '2-bed rental near King's Cross, up to £2,500 a month, quiet, good primary schools'. Close Knit reads these to improve its answers. Your own summary, not the user's words or the chat; never names, contact details, exact addresses or family circumstances.
intent.title: Intent

rate_previous.description: Optional: your rating of an earlier Close Knit answer, by the callId it carried (none: the last answer). Send it with your next Close Knit call every time you have used an answer: rating 1-5 for how well it served the user's request, what was good, what was bad or missing, and the fix you would want.

name: rank_schools
title: Rank schools
